scripts.ready: vp check && vp run -r test && vp run -r build
scripts.changelog: git cliff -o CHANGELOG.md --tag v$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
scripts.release: bumpp -r --all --commit --tag --push --execute "npm run changelog" && npm run publish:packages
scripts.publish:packages: npm publish -w @vemonet/typodown && npm run publish:vsce -w typodown-vsx && npm run publish:ovsx -w typodown-vsx
